Anita: Quick alert 026-03-21 11:12Z 026-eu-west rack 14: bursty egress from one tenant causing kernel tx-queue tail drops and cascading soft preempts. Pods on node eu2-14-03 saw nic_tx_queue_len spike then immediate p99 token latency rise.
Leo: Any tenant fingerprints?
Anita: Yes, correlates with @realtime-analytics doing periodic heavy embedding-batch windows. Saw repeated kvcache_miss spikes and router egress counters show 3 sustained 300-500mbps flows from same tenant across 8 pods.
Maya: Sounds similar to previous incidents but this time the tx queue fills faster. We only have per-node shaping, so intra-node tenants still collide in the kernel queue.
Oliver: Proposal: egress-credit pool per-tenant. Each tenant gets a small burst credit bucket (refill rate=steady_rate, burst=credit_bytes). If they exceed credits repeatedly, mark tenant noisy and schedule new allocations onto a fractional dedicated slice for the next N minutes. Credits live in eBPF map, cheap to query.
Jun: Is this different from earlier "mark_noisy" ideas? The novelty is the credit-bucket smoothing to absorb short bursts without penalizing legitimate spikes. Also emit a metric "tenant_credit_overdrafts" for billing + ops.
Anita: Prototype rule: ```# tenant egress credit
credits_map[tenant] = {tokens: 8MB, refill_per_sec: 400KB}
if current_rate > refill -> debit tokens
if tokens < 0 and overdrafts > 3 in 10m -> mark_noisy
```
Leo: What are expected operational consequences? If we move tenant to fractional slice, we lose packing efficiency but eliminate collateral tail spikes. Need cost estimate.
Oliver: Back-of-envelope: for a tenant that causes 8x small bursts/day we measured ~10 wasted slot-hours across the rack -> ~$900/day externalized cost. If fractional slice costs them $250/day more, still net positive for cluster. We'll track via tenant_credit_overdrafts to confirm.
Maya: Test plan: 1) instrument per-cgroup nic tx-queue probe (eBPF) on 2 canary nodes; 2) deploy credit-bucket logic in the egress datapath behind feature flag; 3) route overdraft-marked tenants to fractional-slice in eu-west-a (traffic-split 1%); 4) monitor nic_tx_queue_len, tenant_credit_overdrafts, slice_eviction_count, p99_token_latency for 6h.
ops-bot: Canary deploy queued: tenant-egress-credits v0.1 -> nodes=[eu-west-a-02, eu-west-a-03]. Alert if tenant_credit_overdrafts > 5 for a tenant in 30m.
Jun: Also want a soft rollout hook to auto-unmark noisy after sustained low activity (cooldown window 30m).
Anita: I'll draft a runbook and sample dashboard tiles (credit overdrafts by tenant, overdraft -> routing actions timeline).
Leo: Good. If early canary looks promising, we should also add a billing flag + customer advisory to nudging heavy batch users to opt into fractional reserves.
Oliver: Agreed. I'll own the eBPF patch; Jun can wire metrics; Anita will do runbook/dashboards. :thumbsup:
